notes: ReceiptsToken (src/ReceiptsToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20: name RECEIPTS, symbol RCPTS, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 RCPTS (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the ProjectFactory. The token has no owner, no mint path after the constructor, no burn, pause, blocklist, freeze, seize or fee on transfer, no proxy and no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT, so the supply can never grow and every transfer moves exactly the amount requested: the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided pool seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager and swaps in either direction all arrive whole without any exemption list. There are no application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
